candidates.title: Draft customer status updates from changing data

demandEvidence.chore: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A student can test with hand-entered sample order states, but no automation reference was supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online shops may pay for clearer status messages; this discussion does not validate buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map a few sample operational fields to draft updates; actual integrations and rules are unknown.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop can draft messages from supplied fields, but a person must resolve missing or changing facts before sending.

evidence.reason: The request names customer-facing updates and incomplete or changing operational data, but gives no recurrence, inputs, or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Concrete requested communication chore, but field rules and relevant implementation evidence are absent; the honest provisional mean is below the 6 threshold.

candidates.title: Send restaurant order notifications

demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A small prototype can accept manually entered test orders, but no supplied building reference supports notification mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small restaurant may pay for setup or maintenance; the post only says the author wants to build this.

feasibility.reason: A four-week demo could pass fictional orders through a chosen notification channel; actual order-system access is unestablished.

autonomy.reason: A test loop can format and route supplied order events, while staff must verify delivery and handle failures.

evidence.reason: The post identifies an automated restaurant order-notification system, but supplies no workflow detail, evidence of repeated demand, or implementation support.

candidates.reason: The requested system is concrete at a high level, but only a build intention is evidenced and implementation support is absent; below threshold.
